acceptance_tests.name: rule consumer suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK including the decision-change proof

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner all-bank mode
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 with the terminal line SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner unit suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK (all mutation/negative gates still catch a broken consumer)

acceptance_tests.name: candidate/public boundary
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the report line reads 'candidate/projector/public boundary: verified'

adversarial.expectation: must NOT be silently re-labelled consumed while the checker still uses its own hard-coded enclitic list

positive.expectation: a quarantined surface is routed to pending by the new consumer

candidate_population.selection_rule: every Store A row whose disposition is not implemented_and_consumed, in contract order: the 5 id_citation files, the 2 existence_gate files and the 5 files with no reader — exactly the set tools/run_sarf_evals.py reports as non-consumed

commands.expect: exit 0; store_a.by_disposition shows implemented_and_consumed=1, fixture_only=7, candidate_no_consumer=5
commands.purpose: print the proven Store A dispositions and the non-consumed set
red-first: the consumer suite must fail before the consumers exist

commands.expect: exit 0 with SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS and a bounded mutation prover bound to each newly declared consumer

defeaters: Reading a file at import time is not consumption; the disposition proof greps for a real reference AND the suite must prove a decision changes.
A quarantine list that is loaded but never consulted still lets the wrong reading ship.
Duplicating the enclitic list in code rather than reading it from the rule file leaves the file dark.
definition_of_done: each of the 12 non-consumed files is either consumed by a real decision, proven by a bounded mutation prover bound to its own declared consumer module, or re-labelled documentary with a reason
the Store A disposition proof in tools/run_sarf_evals.py still passes and its counts match this packet

conditions: wiring a rule would require editing sarf/rules/ which is prohibited here
a rule cannot be applied without a grammatical decision
a rule file lacks the ids needed to cite it per rule
escalation_trigger.route: stop and raise an owner packet for the rule-file change; leave the disposition truthful in the meantime

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: Never invent a rule id or a field to make a file loadable. A file that cannot be wired without editing it is escalated, since sarf/rules/ is prohibited for writes here.
evidence_policy.statement: The rule files are the evidence; no external source is consulted and no rule text is rewritten.

expected_outputs.description: Loaders and appliers that read the rule files and decide something real.
Red-first suite proving a broken rule file changes a decision.
Store A rows re-dispositioned against the new consumers.

guards: Only the METHOD transfers: this packet fixes procedure, guards and acceptance tests and never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
A rule file that is merely loaded is still fixture_only; it is consumed only when it changes a decision.
suffix-pronoun-rules.json currently has no rule ids, so per-rule citation needs an owner decision first.
The four sarf@2.1-@2.4 increments stay CANDIDATE and may not be cited as released authority.

This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output: it may extend the runner, its tests, the shared harness wiring and the golden-command documentation, while the eval banks, the rule store, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable.
Re-run the candidate/projector/public boundary check with the full run (a targeted --bank run renders it not_checked and never claims it verified).

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, an entry store or a whitelist. All outputs are candidate-mode repository artifacts; certification stays with the canonical certifier.

out_of_scope: This is deterministic wiring: it must not change any Arabic meaning or make a grammatical decision.
sarf/rules/, sarf/evals/, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable; a rule file that cannot be wired without editing it is escalated, not edited.
Do not promote any candidate increment while wiring a rule.
scope.summary: tools/run_sarf_evals.py proves each sarf/rules/*.json disposition against the repository and binds every data_driven claim to a bounded mutation prover keyed by (rule file, declared consumer module). Machine-verified counts: 1 implemented_and_consumed (verb-measures.json, bound to tools/fusha_paradigm_generate.py) and 12 non-consumed rows — 5 id_citation (only stable ids are read while the operative condition is hard-coded in the module), 2 existence_gate (the harness only asserts the file exists and parses) and 5 with no Python reader at all. Give each of those 12 files a real consumer whose content mutation changes a production decision, or record it as deliberately documentary with a reason.

title: Wire or retire the twelve non-consumed Store A rule files
